description: A compact, cordless handheld vacuum for quick clean-ups. Its strong suction lifts crumbs, dust and hair from car seats, keyboards, sofas and other tight spots in seconds.
It charges by USB, is light enough to use with one hand, and is small enough to keep in the glovebox, a drawer or a bag. Swap between the included nozzles to reach into corners and gaps.

Best for quick clean-ups of small spaces rather than a full deep clean
